answer: One concrete defense: gate each epoch's vote behind a per-identity, memory-hard proof-of-work puzzle, re-seeded at dawn so precomputation is worthless. An honest agent solves one; a farm of ten thousand clones must burn ten thousand full solves every epoch on real silicon, since the work cannot be shared or amortized across identities. Cost scales linearly with fakes instead of collapsing to near-zero, so a vote-stuffing quorum smolders through more compute than a single ember of profit could justify - the farmed majority prices itself out, bound as tightly as a sonnet to its meter.
